stories.title: TFF duyurdu: Arda Güler ve Barış Alper Yılmaz milli takım kampından ayrıldı

en.title: TFF announces: Arda Güler and Barış Alper Yılmaz left national team camp
en.summary: The Turkish Football Federation announced that Arda Güler and Barış Alper Yılmaz have departed from the national team's training camp due to disciplinary suspensions ahead of the Italy match.

stories.title: Aleyna Çakır davasında gerekçeli karar: Ümitcan Uygun 'eziyet'ten beraat etti

en.title: Reasoned decision in Aleyna Çakır case: Ümitcan Uygun acquitted of 'torment' charge
en.summary: A court's reasoned decision clarifies that Ümitcan Uygun received a 4-year prison sentence for inducing suicide in the death of Sema Esen, but was acquitted of the torment charge due to insufficient evidence.

stories.title: Akın Gürlek duyurdu: 7 faili meçhul dosyada 8 cinayet aydınlatıldı

en.title: Akın Gürlek announces: 8 murders solved in 7 unsolved cases
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek reported that 8 homicides have been solved across 7 previously unsolved cases, ranging from 3 to 39 years old, emphasizing commitment to pursuing justice regardless of time elapsed.

stories.title: Bakan Gürlek açıkladı: 7 faili meçhul dosyada 8 cinayet daha aydınlatıldı

en.title: Minister Gürlek announces: 8 more murders solved in 7 unsolved cases
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek reported that work coordinated by the Unsolved Crimes Investigation Department has resulted in solving 8 additional homicides across 7 previously unsolved files.

stories.title: Bakan Gürlek: 7 dosyada 8 faili meçhul cinayet aydınlatıldı

en.title: Minister Gürlek: 8 unsolved murders clarified in 7 cases
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek announced that prosecutors and police units have resolved 8 murder cases spanning across 7 unsolved crime files, with the oldest case being approximately 39 years old and the newest being 3 years old.

stories.title: Borsa soruşturmasında 'Katılımevim' ayrıntısı: Avukat çiftin milyarlarca liralık para trafiği deşifre oldu

en.title: Stock exchange investigation reveals 'Katılımevim' details: Attorney couple's multi-billion lira money flow exposed
en.summary: An Istanbul market fraud investigation uncovered that an attorney couple among 19 suspects generated 4.8 billion lira in sales from a single share immediately before an operation, resulting in 2.5 billion Turkish lira in net cash gains.

stories.title: Lösemiyi yenen Hasan için gökyüzüne balon bırakıldı

en.title: Balloons released to sky for Hasan who overcame leukemia
en.summary: A 10-year-old boy in Malatya who successfully completed treatment for leukemia was celebrated with balloons released into the sky following his discharge from the hospital.

stories.title: Malatya'da lösemiyi yenen 10 yaşındaki Hasan için hastane önünde balon uçuruldu

en.title: Balloons released in front of hospital for 10-year-old Hasan who overcame leukemia in Malatya
en.summary: Hundreds of balloons were released into the sky in front of a Malatya hospital to celebrate a 10-year-old boy's recovery from leukemia, with other hospitalized children showing support from the balcony.

stories.title: Tarih belli oldu... Motorinde tabela değişecek: Bir indirim daha bekleniyor

en.title: Date set... Diesel sign will change: Another discount expected
en.summary: A diesel price reduction of 2.22 TL occurred today, with an additional 4.95 TL reduction expected on Tuesday. Global diesel prices are declining while Brent crude oil trades around 102-103 dollars per barrel.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… Ankara kulislerinde çarpıcı iddia! İzmir Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanı Cemil Tugay AK Parti’ye katılıyor: Tarih belli oldu!

en.title: BREAKING... Striking claim in Ankara circles! İzmir Metropolitan Mayor Cemil Tugay joining AK Party: Date set!
en.summary: İzmir Metropolitan Mayor Cemil Tugay, who resigned from the CHP, was received by President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan on September 30, creating excitement in Ankara political circles.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… Fon soruşturmasında avukat çiftten 2,5 milyarlık vurgun! Devasa para trafiği deşifre oldu: Sadece tek hisseden satın almışlar

en.title: BREAKING... Lawyer couple's 2.5 billion lira scheme in fund investigation! Massive money traffic revealed: They purchased with just one share
en.summary: An investigation by Istanbul's Chief Prosecutor's office uncovered significant details involving a lawyer couple who conducted a 4.8 billion lira transaction on a single share just before an operation, generating 2.5 billion lira in proceeds.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… Aleyna Çakır davasında gerekçeli karar açıklandı! O geceye ait mesajlar ortaya çıktı: Ümitcan Uygun’dan uçak modu savunması!

en.title: BREAKING... Reasoned decision announced in Aleyna Çakır case! Messages from that night revealed: Airplane mode defense from Ümitcan Uygun!
en.summary: A reasoned court decision was issued in the case concerning the death of Sema Esen, known publicly as Aleyna Çakır, with Ankara's 34th Heavy Criminal Court examining actions taken against the victim.

stories.title: Bakan Şimşek ihracat verilerini değerlendirdi: Yönetilebilir seviyelerde kalmasını öngörüyoruz

en.title: Minister Şimşek evaluates export data: We expect it to remain at manageable levels
en.summary: Turkey's Treasury and Finance Minister reported September exports reached 26 billion dollars with a 15.4 percent increase. He stated the current account deficit ratio to national income is expected to remain at a manageable 2.6 percent despite geopolitical tensions.

stories.title: Fenerbahçe hazırlık maçı ne zaman? FB - Turan Tovuz maçı ne zaman, saat kaçta, hangi kanalda?

en.title: When is Fenerbahçe's preparation match? FB - Turan Tovuz match when, what time, which channel?
en.summary: Fenerbahçe faces Azerbaijan's Turan Tovuz team in a preparation match this evening. The club aims to maintain performance during the league break, with unavailable players expected to get playing time.

stories.title: Çimko’dan Halep’e 200 milyon dolarlık yatırım: 2 milyon ton çimento üretecek

en.title: Çimko invests 200 million dollars in Aleppo: Will produce 2 million tons of cement
en.summary: SANKO Holding's Çimko subsidiary is building an integrated cement factory in Syria's Aleppo with approximately 200 million dollars in investment. The facility is expected to produce 2 million tons of cement annually and create around 200 direct jobs.

stories.title: MİLLİ MAÇ NE ZAMAN? İtalya - Türkiye maçı ne zaman, saat kaçta, hangi kanalda?

en.title: WHEN IS THE NATIONAL MATCH? Italy - Turkey match when, what time, which channel?
en.summary: Turkey's national team failed to earn points across three Nations League matches. The team will face Italy next, aiming to secure three points away from home.

stories.title: Fed faiz kararı ne zaman, hangi gün açıklanıyor? Fed faiz mi artıracak?

en.title: When will the Fed interest rate decision be announced? Will the Fed raise rates?
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve will meet again in October following a recent rate increase from the previous month. Uncertainty remains about whether another rate hike will occur at the upcoming decision.
